final_review.behavior: When the real process-discovery command fails, closing a row reports failure, archives nothing, and keeps the actionable row in the active list.
final_review.failure_caught: A discovery failure treated as 'nothing running', archiving a row whose process may still exist.
final_review.criticality_reason: A failed discovery produces DiscoveryFailed ('process ownership is uncertain', crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/session/mod.rs:50-63) and the record keeps a row whose owning group was never proven stopped; the wrong-ownership consequence is bounded because nothing is signalled or deleted and unarchive restores the row, so this is 3 rather than a destructive or data-loss failure.
final_review.signal_reason: Injects a failing ps ahead of the server's PATH, asserts the CLI failure, an empty archive and the row still active (tests/retained_sessions.rs:2466-2513).
final_review.uniqueness_reason: The discovery-failure branch is unique; the archived-uncertainty test covers a known archived row (tests/retained_sessions.rs:2019-2143).
final_review.fidelity_reason: Real binary, a real wrapper process and the real ps command, so attached_subgroups() at crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/session/mod.rs:838-849 executes its production error path; the OS discovery boundary is the subject.
final_review.recommendation_reason: Only test of a real discovery command failure during close.
cost_drivers: A PATH wrapper and one close request

final_review.behavior: d on a task opens a confirmation and emits nothing; Esc cancels; d then y emits the delete.
final_review.failure_caught: A destructive key acting immediately, or Esc submitting the pending action.
final_review.criticality_reason: The confirmation is the only guard before deleting a task and cancelling its queued runs (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/task_tui.rs:930-960).
final_review.signal_reason: Four small assertions on requests before/after the confirmation (tests/task_tui.rs:231-240).
final_review.uniqueness_reason: Distinct sequence boundary: this row cancels a pending confirmation with Esc and then re-arms and accepts the same action on the SAME view (tests/task_tui.rs:231-242), while the named neighbour task_confirmations_honor_default_no_and_case_insensitive_answers builds a fresh fixture for every answer (tests/task_tui.rs:471-536) and therefore never observes a cancellation followed by a successful confirmation on one instance.
final_review.recommendation_reason: Kept after round-2 independent review: the only named survivor constructs a new view per answer and never exercises cancel-then-reconfirm on one instance, so full subsumption (U=0) is unsupported; the cancellation/re-arm sequence is the distinct boundary and has no other protector.
cost_drivers: Four key events on the task view
